Class GameViewController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.GameViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserInterface
public class GameViewController extends Object implements UserInterface
Controller for GameScreen.fxml — a thin orchestrator over a single ObjectProperty<GameStateDTO> that drives the whole UI.

Responsibilities are delegated to focused collaborators: GuiNodeFactory (node/image construction), PopupFactory (popups), TotemLayerManager (board totems), OpponentPanel (opponent ring + menu) and ResponsiveLayout (scaling + background). This controller keeps only the reactive wiring, the local HUD bindings and the interactive card-selection state.

Entry point: onGameEvent(GameEventDTO) — called from the network thread.
